papers.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
papers.abstract_en: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.
papers.abstract_zh: 如今的人工智能工作负载正在快速变化：新模型发布更加频繁，模型架构日益多样，流量分布也频繁改变。我们在 Together AI 面临的挑战是针对这些变化的工作负载进行持续优化。将一次部署编译为优化的前向传播，是一个非常适合用智能体爬山法解决的问题。现有系统由于测量吞吐量与保真度之间的权衡，难以实现持续编译。许多系统使用智能体通过离线基准来优化推理前向传播中的单个内核，但由于混合专家（MoE）等原语中的数据依赖行为，计时保真度较低。另一方面，系统使用智能体直接优化端到端引擎，但受困于引擎启动时间缓慢。为应对这些挑战，我们构建了 Together Compiler（TKCC），这是首个真正为 AI 推理优化设计的持续智能体循环。为解决吞吐量与保真度之间的权衡，我们提出：（1）分层持久引擎，将引擎启动开销与前向传播计算解耦；（2）一个成本模型，用于选择为优化过程提供种子的并行配置。我们还对智能体上下文管理进行了大量消融实验，并展示了在生产环境中部署 TKCC 的见解。在 Llama 1B 主力工作负载上，TKCC 相比高度优化的手写 Megakernels 最高提升 1.7 倍；在 InferenceX 基准上，跨硬件平台相比最新前沿模型（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）上的最佳开源引擎，TPS 最高提升 2.6 倍。TKCC 还在批大小为 1 时创下最先进性能，在 M3.1 Flash 上达到 1111 TPS，在 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 上达到 1205 TPS。最后，TKCC 可泛化到前沿语言模型推理之外。TKCC 在我们的生产集群中服务了数万亿个 token。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出 Together Compiler（TKCC）持续智能体编译循环，通过分层持久引擎与成本模型解决吞吐量-保真度权衡，在 Llama 1B 上较手写 Megakernels 最高提升 1.7 倍、在 InferenceX 基准上较最佳开源引擎最高提升 2.6 倍 TPS。

papers.title: Teach with Blinks: Breaking Linguistic Momentum in On-Policy Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training approach to improving fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models by amortizing costly inference-time zooming operations into a single-pass recipe. However, vanilla OPD is inherently susceptible to linguistic momentum: the teacher can follow the student's erroneous prefixes, thus weakening corrective supervision. To address this, we propose Blink On-Policy Distillation (BlinkOPD), in which the teacher "blinks" at every token: it reads the same prefix once with its eyes open and once with its eyes closed. A first-glance gain further strengthens the correction on rollouts that conflict with the teacher. By extracting more effective supervision from each on-policy trajectory, BlinkOPD achieves state-of-the-art average performance across six fine-grained benchmarks using only 500 training images (12x less data) than existing OPD methods. Beyond fine-grained perception, BlinkOPD also demonstrates strong zero-shot improvements across ten held-out benchmarks spanning general visual perception, visual hallucination, and multimodal reasoning abilities. Code: https://github.com/Supltz/BlinkOPD
papers.abstract_zh: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为一种有效的后训练方法，通过将昂贵的推理时缩放操作摊销为单次前向配方，来提升多模态大语言模型的细粒度感知能力。然而，原始 OPD 本质上易受语言惯性影响：教师模型可能跟随学生的错误前缀，从而削弱纠正性监督。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Blink On-Policy Distillation（BlinkOPD），其中教师模型在每个 token 处“眨眼”：它分别以睁眼和闭眼的方式读取同一前缀。首次一瞥增益进一步加强对与教师模型冲突的 rollout 的纠正。通过从每条在线策略轨迹中提取更有效的监督，BlinkOPD 仅使用 500 张训练图像（比现有 OPD 方法少 12 倍数据），就在六个细粒度基准上取得最先进的平均性能。除细粒度感知外，BlinkOPD 还在涵盖通用视觉感知、视觉幻觉和多模态推理能力的十个留出基准上展现出强大的零样本提升。代码：https://github.com/Supltz/BlinkOPD
papers.tldr_zh: 提出 BlinkOPD，让教师模型对同一前缀分别以睁眼和闭眼方式读取以打破在线策略蒸馏中的语言惯性，仅用 500 张训练图像即在六个细粒度基准上取得最先进平均性能。
why_it_matters: 匹配 LLM：large language model, language model
匹配 MLLM / VLM：multimodal large language model
匹配 预训练 / 后训练：post-training
limitations: 当前仅检查标题和摘要，尚未核验正文、实验细节与可复现性。

papers.title: Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 离散扩散生成通过迭代细化对整个 token 序列去噪，正成为自回归生成的有竞争力替代方案。其全局规划和渐进纠正能力特别适合自动驾驶。然而，将这一生成范式从通用设置迁移到驾驶领域，会在训练和推理两方面引入显著的领域差距。为释放其潜力，我们提出一种面向标准视觉-语言模型架构的多阶段优化流水线，无需辅助动作专家或专门的混合专家 Transformer，涵盖后训练与推理。在监督微调期间，我们优化规划输入的表示，以抑制任务响应中的幻觉。在强化学习期间，我们引入指标引导的多样性过滤，以识别更强的学习起点并改善策略探索。在推理时，我们提出动态自动驾驶解码（DAD），根据场景复杂度自适应调整解码模式。基于该流水线，我们开发了 Masked Diffusion Drive（MD-Drive），相比未优化模型性能提升 29.7%。在 NAVSIM 闭环基准以及 nuScenes 和 DriveCoT 开环数据集上的实验表明，MD-Drive 优于相同架构的自回归 VLM 基线，同时通过离散扩散训练与推理，在不同架构系统之间实现了更有利的性能与计算成本平衡。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出面向标准视觉-语言模型的多阶段优化流水线（含监督微调表示优化、指标引导多样性过滤与动态自动驾驶解码 DAD），据此构建的 MD-Drive 相比未优化模型提升 29.7%，并在 NAVSIM、nuScenes 和 DriveCoT 上优于同架构自回归 VLM 基线。

匹配 预训练 / 后训练：post-training
匹配 模型架构：model architecture

papers.title: Vision-Grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment for Scalable Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) aims to retrieve individuals with texts in multiple languages. Despite its practical importance, it has been overlooked by existing research, which mainly focuses on English-only retrieval. The only prior attempt at multilingual TBPR suffers from (1) the absence of a large-scale, multilingual pretraining dataset and (2) a suboptimal model architecture for multilingual text encoding and cross-modal alignment, which employs a shared encoder that overlooks linguistic heterogeneity and relies on English as a pivot for cross-modal alignment, introducing English-centric bias. For this, we contribute MultiPedes, the first large-scale, pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset. It contains 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, constructed by a multilingual quality-aware data construction pipeline. We also propose ViSeLA (Vision-grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment), a novel framework featuring: (1) a semantic-aware multilingual learning module that extends the mixture-of-experts architecture by routing language-invariant semantics to specialized experts for improved multilingual feature learning; and (2) a vision-grounded cross-modal alignment module that employs a semantic probe to capture fine-grained semantics across modalities, enabling direct cross-modal alignment without relying on a pivot language. Extensive experiments on both multilingual and English-only TBPR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ViSeLA. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/ViSeLA
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言基于文本的行人检索（TBPR）旨在用多种语言的文本检索行人。尽管具有实际重要性，现有研究主要关注仅英文检索，因而忽视了该任务。此前唯一的多语言 TBPR 尝试存在以下不足：（1）缺少大规模多语言预训练数据集；（2）多语言文本编码与跨模态对齐的模型架构欠佳，其采用共享编码器，忽视了语言异质性，并依赖英语作为跨模态对齐的枢纽，引入英语中心偏差。为此，我们贡献了 MultiPedes，首个大规模、以行人为中心的多语言预训练数据集。它包含四种语言的 1000 万图文对，由多语言质量感知数据构建流水线构建。我们还提出 ViSeLA（视觉接地的语义学习与对齐），一种新颖框架，具有：（1）语义感知多语言学习模块，通过将语言不变语义路由到专门专家来扩展混合专家架构，以改进多语言特征学习；（2）视觉接地的跨模态对齐模块，采用语义探针捕获跨模态的细粒度语义，实现不依赖枢纽语言的直接跨模态对齐。在多语言和仅英文 TBPR 数据集上的大量实验证明了 ViSeLA 的有效性。数据集和代码见 https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/ViSeLA
papers.tldr_zh: 构建首个大规模多语言行人检索预训练数据集 MultiPedes（四语言 1000 万图文对），并提出 ViSeLA 框架，以语义感知混合专家路由和视觉接地跨模态对齐替代英语枢纽，在多语言与仅英文 TBPR 数据集上验证有效。

papers.title: MusicRWKV: A Multimodal RWKV Framework for Music Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent music foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in music representation learning, yet most existing approaches rely on Transformer architectures whose quadratic attention complexity introduces substantial computational and memory overhead when modeling long-duration music recordings. In this work, we propose MusicRWKV, a multimodal music representation learning framework built upon the RWKV architecture. MusicRWKV jointly models waveform, spectrogram, and metadata information within a unified self-supervised learning framework. To improve efficiency for long musical sequences, we introduce an invertible compression module that reduces sequence length while preserving reconstruction capability. A FiLM-based conditioning strategy is employed to facilitate modality-aware representation learning without introducing expensive cross-attention operations. We further investigate the integration of Soft ROSA as a differentiable retrieval mechanism for neural-symbolic interaction. Experimental evaluation across a diverse collection of Music Information Retrieval (MIR) benchmarks demonstrates that the proposed RWKV-based architecture can be effectively adapted to heterogeneous music understanding tasks. A controlled pretraining ablation shows that Soft ROSA improves validation performance, while layer-wise telemetry analysis reveals a progressive transition from distributed retrieval to selective retrieval in deeper network layers. These results suggest that RWKV provides a promising architectural alternative to Transformer-based models for multimodal music understanding.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的音乐基础模型在音乐表示学习方面取得了显著进展，但大多数现有方法依赖 Transformer 架构，其二次注意力复杂度在建模长时音乐录音时带来大量计算和内存开销。在本工作中，我们提出 MusicRWKV，一个基于 RWKV 架构的多模态音乐表示学习框架。MusicRWKV 在统一的自监督学习框架内联合建模波形、频谱图和元数据信息。为提升长音乐序列的效率，我们引入可逆压缩模块，在保持重建能力的同时缩短序列长度。采用基于 FiLM 的条件策略促进模态感知表示学习，而不引入昂贵的交叉注意力操作。我们进一步研究了将 Soft ROSA 集成为可微检索机制，用于神经-符号交互。在多样化音乐信息检索（MIR）基准集合上的实验评估表明，所提出的基于 RWKV 的架构可有效适配异构音乐理解任务。一项受控预训练消融显示 Soft ROSA 提升了验证性能，而逐层遥测分析揭示了深层网络中从分布式检索到选择性检索的渐进转变。这些结果表明，RWKV 为多模态音乐理解提供了有前景的 Transformer 架构替代方案。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出基于 RWKV 的多模态音乐表示学习框架 MusicRWKV，联合建模波形、频谱图与元数据，并用可逆压缩模块和 FiLM 条件策略提升长序列效率，在多项 MIR 基准上验证其可适配异构音乐理解任务。

匹配 模型架构：transformer architecture

papers.title: Description-Guided CLIP Adaptation with Local Evidence Calibration for Few-Shot Plant Disease Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Accurate plant disease recognition is essential for intelligent agriculture, but few-shot settings provide limited labeled samples that may not capture diagnostic symptoms and intra-class variations. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, offer transferable visual-semantic knowledge. However, existing CLIP-based methods often rely on coarse class semantics and global visual representations, overlooking disease-specific diagnostic information and fine-grained local cues. Excessive few-shot adaptation may also cause over-specialization and weaken the generalization ability of large-scale pre-training. We propose a description-guided, two-stage CLIP adaptation method to address these issues. Symptom and comparative descriptions enrich class semantics with typical visual symptoms and discriminative cues between similar diseases. The enhanced semantics guide the aggregation of class-relevant patch evidence to calibrate global image-text matching with fine-grained cues. For adaptation, we first update the vision-language encoders with lightweight parameters, then freeze them and train a linear classifier. At inference, the classifier is used for in-domain prediction, while class prototypes from the adapted text encoder support cross-domain prediction and retain vision-language transferability. Experiments with two backbones show that our method achieves the highest mean accuracy in most few-shot settings on PlantVillage, Cassava, and Pear, reaching 93.16%, 79.30%, and 96.56%, respectively, with ViT-L/14 under 16-shot. On class-aligned cross-domain evaluation across 21 shared PlantDoc classes, it achieves 56.96% accuracy, outperforming all compared methods. These results demonstrate its effectiveness in fine-grained few-shot plant disease recognition and cross-domain generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确的植物病害识别对智慧农业至关重要，但少样本设置下可用的标注样本有限，可能无法捕捉诊断性症状和类内变化。预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）提供了可迁移的视觉-语义知识。然而，现有基于 CLIP 的方法往往依赖粗粒度的类别语义和全局视觉表示，忽略了病害特有的诊断信息和细粒度局部线索。过度的少样本适配还可能导致过度特化，削弱大规模预训练的泛化能力。我们提出一种描述引导的两阶段 CLIP 适配方法来解决这些问题。症状描述和对比描述用典型视觉症状及相似病害间的判别性线索来丰富类别语义。增强后的语义引导类别相关图像块证据的聚合，以细粒度线索校准全局图文匹配。在适配方面，我们首先用轻量参数更新视觉-语言编码器，然后冻结它们并训练一个线性分类器。推理时，分类器用于域内预测，而来自适配后文本编码器的类别原型支持跨域预测并保留视觉-语言可迁移性。在两个骨干网络上的实验表明，我们的方法在 PlantVillage、Cassava 和 Pear 上的大多数少样本设置中取得最高平均准确率，在 ViT-L/14 和 16-shot 下分别达到 93.16%、79.30% 和 96.56%。在 21 个共享 PlantDoc 类别上的类别对齐跨域评估中，它达到 56.96% 的准确率，优于所有对比方法。这些结果证明了其在细粒度少样本植物病害识别和跨域泛化方面的有效性。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出描述引导的两阶段 CLIP 适配方法，用症状与对比描述增强类别语义并聚合局部图像块证据校准图文匹配，在 PlantVillage、Cassava、Pear 少样本识别及 PlantDoc 跨域评估上取得最高准确率。

匹配 预训练 / 后训练：pre-training

papers.title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
authors: Andrea Fernandez Tostado Ro. Diego Andrea
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 通用语言模型主要用英语训练：在我们调研的开放模型中，非英语预训练数据占比最多仅为 12%。为欧洲语言构建的模型给这些语言的数据远多于此，但得分远低于同等规模的通用模型。一个常见担忧是，在小模型中，各语言会争夺容量。我们提出 Lara Mini base，一个从零开始训练、使用 6T token 的模型，涵盖英语和其他 44 种语言，这些语言合起来覆盖欧盟全部 24 种官方语言。随着训练推进，这 44 种其他语言合计权重超过英语。为以低成本给这些语言足够容量，Lara Mini base 采用专家混合架构，总参数 7.2B、激活参数 0.6B。在激活参数不超过 2B 的开放基础模型中，它在标准英语、多语言、数学和代码基准上的平均得分最高，领先于用 4 至 6 倍 token 训练的模型。其优势在其支持语言的多语言基准和数学基准上最大。它支持最长 128k token 的上下文。我们发现我们的 MoE 架构减少了语言间的容量竞争。对单 GPU 上的单个用户，在未量化情况下，其文本生成速度至少比任何平均得分更高的模型快 1.8 倍。我们以 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可发布 Lara Mini base 的权重。此外，我们将发布 T-HellaSwag，即常识推理基准 HellaSwag 的 110 个语言变体的更高质量机器翻译版本。
papers.tldr_zh: 从零训练覆盖英语及 44 种语言的 6T token 专家混合模型 Lara Mini base（总参数 7.2B、激活 0.6B），在激活参数不超过 2B 的开放基础模型中平均基准得分最高，并发现 MoE 架构可减少语言间容量竞争。

papers.title: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了显著进展，视觉-语言模型（VLM）的空间推理能力仍然有限。前馈三维重建的最新进展使得从视觉输入进行精确、实时的几何理解成为可能。在本工作中，我们提出 SpaceMCP，一个利用这些进展、为空间推理引入 MCP 式范式的框架。我们的方法为 VLM 增加结构化函数调用，使其能够查询场景图以获取距离、物体定位和相机属性等空间信息。场景图使用前馈三维重建实时构建以恢复度量几何，并结合开放词汇分割来识别和定位场景中的相关物体。配合 VLM 强大的推理能力，VLM 能够组合这些原始信息来解决更复杂的空间任务。在无需任何训练的情况下，SpaceMCP 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 VSTI-Bench 上取得最先进结果，优于近期经过空间后训练的 VLM，并在每个基准上将其基础 VLM 提升 15-22 分。我们认为，鉴于原生 VLM 空间推理进展相对缓慢与前馈三维计算机视觉快速进步之间的反差，这一范式为实现稳健空间推理提供了一条有前景的路径。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出 SpaceMCP，用前馈三维重建与开放词汇分割实时构建场景图，让 VLM 通过结构化函数调用查询空间信息，无需训练即在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench、VSTI-Bench 上取得最先进结果并较基础 VLM 提升 15-22 分。
why_it_matters: 匹配 LLM：large language model, language model
匹配 MLLM / VLM：vision-language model, vision language model, vlm

papers.title: Understanding Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Beyond Expert Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. Reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. To clarify these differing accounts, we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP), a measure developed for this analysis. Using mixed-domain calibration data, we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain, compared with 15-24% across domains. To understand how this organization evolves during training, we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open MoE families. Neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings, while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. Building on these neuron-level perspectives, we further introduce RAMP-based Pruning (RAMPr) to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. At 75% neuron retention, RAMPr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. At 50% retention, our pruning method can reduce resident GPU memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/ydyjya/Neuron-Level-Specialization-in-MoE
papers.abstract_zh: 在混合专家（MoE）模型中，专家专门化的本质仍存在争议。关于专家偏好与领域相关的报告，与将路由主要归因于token身份或句法模式的分析形成对比。为厘清这些不同解释，我们超越专家级路由，利用为分析开发的Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling（RAMP）度量，研究领域专门化计算在神经元层面的组织。使用混合领域校准数据，我们识别出领域专门化神经元集合，同一领域多源样本间的重叠率为58-74%，而跨领域重叠率为15-24%。为理解这种组织在训练中如何演变，我们在三个完全开放的MoE系列中追踪预训练和后训练期间的神经元重要性。尽管专家级重要性排名相对稳定，神经元重要性在预训练检查点之间持续重组，而后训练基本保持神经元排名。基于这些神经元层面视角，我们进一步引入基于RAMP的剪枝（RAMPr），跨专家选择神经元以平衡多领域能力保持。在75%神经元保留率下，RAMPr在六个模型上平均保留原始完整性能的91-98%。在50%保留率下，我们的剪枝方法可将常驻GPU内存减少36-43%，并将批量预填充吞吐量有效提升17-39%。我们的代码见https://github.com/ydyjya/Neuron-Level-Specialization-in-MoE。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出RAMP度量揭示MoE模型领域专门化计算在神经元层面的组织及其训练演变，并据此设计RAMPr剪枝方法，在保留多领域能力的同时降低显存并提升吞吐。
why_it_matters: 匹配 预训练 / 后训练：pre-training, post-training
evidence: 开放资源信号：code is available

papers.title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspective of multi-domain data, we propose a Multi-Domain Feature Extractor that adaptively captures temporal dependencies and channel correlations based on domain-specific characteristics, including progressive multi-scale modeling and adaptive slot channel modeling. From the perspective of the diversity of tasks, we propose multi-task collaborative training, which leverages task specificity and task commonality through task customization and cross-task training, effectively unifying multiple tasks in pre-training and better adapting to diverse downstream scenarios. After pre-training on large-scale time series data, TimeSeek achieves state-of-the-art performance in forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification tasks across both few-shot learning and zero-shot situations, together with favorable inference efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列分析已广泛应用于各个领域。尽管现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）已展现出良好结果，但仍面临两大挑战：1）大多数TSFM主要依赖堆叠Transformer层来增加参数量，缺乏从多领域数据自适应建模复杂时间序列模式的能力。2）当前TSFM主要针对特定任务（如预测或异常检测）预训练，少数模型支持多任务，但未能充分利用任务特异性和共性，导致性能次优。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TimeSeek，一种新颖的广义时间序列分析模型，可从多领域数据自适应建模时间序列模式并在预训练中统一多任务。在概念上，TimeSeek以领域和任务异质性下的选择性信息共享为指导。从多领域数据角度，我们提出多领域特征提取器，基于领域特定特性自适应捕获时间依赖和通道相关性，包括渐进多尺度建模和自适应槽通道建模。从任务多样性角度，我们提出多任务协同训练，通过任务定制和跨任务训练利用任务特异性和任务共性，在预训练中有效统一多任务并更好适应多样下游场景。在大规模时间序列数据上预训练后，TimeSeek在少样本和零样本情况下的预测、异常检测和分类任务上均达到最先进性能，并具有良好推理效率。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出TimeSeek，通过多领域特征提取器与多任务协同训练在预训练中统一多任务，在预测、异常检测和分类的少样本与零样本场景下取得最先进性能。
why_it_matters: 匹配 预训练 / 后训练：pretraining, pre-training

papers.title: ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models pre-trained on large unlabeled electroencephalography (EEG) corpora have emerged as a transformative paradigm for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) applications. Recent EEG foundation models have shown that multi-scale representations derived from fixed-length patches can improve EEG representation learning. Existing frameworks commonly construct temporal scales through feature-level operations. However, these operations leave the correspondence between learned features and scale-specific characteristics of the original EEG signals implicit. Moreover, when the self-supervised objective is not aligned with the multi-scale input representations, information at some temporal scales may receive insufficient supervision during pre-training. In light of this, we propose ScaleBrain, a scale-consistent pre-training framework that explicitly coordinates multi-scale representations of EEG from both the model input and optimization objective sides. Specifically, ScaleBrain introduces multi-scale EEG tokenization to represent the same EEG segment through analysis windows with different temporal spans and shared temporal anchors, and pairs these representations with scale-specific reconstruction to align with the multi-scale input structure and provide supervision across temporal resolutions during self-supervised learning. We further develop an axial spatio-temporal attention mechanism to contextualize the fused multi-scale representation along spatial and temporal dimensions. Extensive evaluations on six public BCI benchmarks against 12 representative baselines show that ScaleBrain achieves the highest mean Balanced Accuracy on five datasets and ranks third on the remaining one, with only 5.0M parameters, demonstrating strong performance and favorable parameter efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大规模无标签脑电图（EEG）语料上预训练的基础模型已成为脑机接口（BCI）应用的变革性范式。近期EEG基础模型表明，源自固定长度分块的多尺度表示可改善EEG表示学习。现有框架通常通过特征级操作构建时间尺度。然而，这些操作使学习到的特征与原始EEG信号的尺度特定特性之间的对应关系保持隐式。此外，当自监督目标与多尺度输入表示不对齐时，某些时间尺度的信息在预训练期间可能获得不足的监督。鉴于此，我们提出ScaleBrain，一种尺度一致的预训练框架，从模型输入和优化目标两方面显式协调EEG的多尺度表示。具体而言，ScaleBrain引入多尺度EEG分词，通过具有不同时间跨度和共享时间锚点的分析窗口表示同一EEG片段，并将这些表示与尺度特定重建配对，以对齐多尺度输入结构并在自监督学习期间跨时间分辨率提供监督。我们进一步开发轴向时空注意力机制，沿空间和时间维度对融合的多尺度表示进行上下文化。在六个公开BCI基准上与12个代表性基线进行广泛评估，结果表明ScaleBrain在五个数据集上取得最高平均平衡准确率，在其余一个上排名第三，且仅有5.0M参数，展现出强性能和良好的参数效率。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出ScaleBrain，从输入分词与重建目标两侧协调EEG多尺度表示，并采用轴向时空注意力，以仅5.0M参数在多数BCI基准上取得最高平均平衡准确率。

匹配 模型架构：attention mechanism

papers.title: Pothole Risk Assessment with Geometrically Grounded Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Potholes impose billions of dollars in annual vehicle damage, yet detectors report only where potholes are, not how severe they are or what to do. Judging severity from a single RGB image is ill-posed, and ungrounded vision-language model (VLM) assessments tend to be over-conservative. We present a five-stage modular framework for the offline assessment of already-detected potholes that combines geometric measurements with VLM reasoning: perspective transformation, zero-shot SAM segmentation, geometric feature extraction, Gemini 2.5 Pro severity classification with composite risk scoring, and natural-language warning generation. We evaluate it on 3,092 potholes in 1,119 dashcam scenes against independent references. Severity agreement with a prediction-free three-annotator panel is weak (Cohen's $κ= 0.139$, 95% CI [0.00, 0.28]; $n = 101$) and far below the annotators' agreement with one another ($κ= 0.605$); against physically measured depth on an independent RGB-D dataset, it is also weak ($κ= 0.098$), although the predicted classes preserve the order of measured depths. The severity classes are therefore perceived visual categories, not depth measurements. Geometric grounding does change the warnings: relative to an image-only baseline, it moves 26.7% of scenes out of the high-urgency tier and raises critical-tier assignments by 109% (Stuart-Maxwell $p < 10^{-15}$), and in a blind study, three raters preferred the grounded warnings 3.5:1. A six-arm prompt ablation attributes the hybrid prompt's rule adherence to the per-pothole measurements rather than to the rubric or worked examples. At USD 0.105 per scene, it suits large-scale offline infrastructure assessment; its maneuver suggestions are advisory research outputs, not validated vehicle guidance.
papers.abstract_zh: 坑洞每年造成数十亿美元的车辆损坏，然而检测器只报告坑洞在哪里，而不报告其严重程度或应采取什么措施。从单张 RGB 图像判断严重程度是不适定的，而未接地的视觉-语言模型（VLM）评估往往过于保守。我们提出一个五阶段模块化框架，用于对已检测到的坑洞进行离线评估，将几何测量与 VLM 推理相结合：透视变换、零样本 SAM 分割、几何特征提取、Gemini 2.5 Pro 严重程度分类与复合风险评分，以及自然语言警告生成。我们在 1,119 个行车记录仪场景中的 3,092 个坑洞上，对照独立参考进行评估。与无预测的三标注者小组的严重程度一致性较弱（Cohen's κ = 0.139，95% CI [0.00, 0.28]；n = 101），远低于标注者彼此之间的一致性（κ = 0.605）；在独立 RGB-D 数据集上对照物理测量深度，一致性同样较弱（κ = 0.098），尽管预测类别保持了测量深度的顺序。因此，严重程度类别是感知到的视觉类别，而非深度测量。几何接地确实改变了警告：相对于仅图像基线，它使 26.7% 的场景移出高紧急层级，并使关键层级分配增加 109%（Stuart-Maxwell p < 10^-15），在一项盲研究中，三名评分者以 3.5:1 的比例更偏好接地警告。六臂提示消融将混合提示的规则遵循归因于逐坑洞测量，而非评分标准或示例。每场景 0.105 美元的成本适合大规模离线基础设施评估；其机动建议是咨询性研究输出，而非经过验证的车辆指导。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出结合透视变换、零样本 SAM 分割与几何特征提取及 Gemini 2.5 Pro 分类的五阶段框架评估坑洞风险，几何接地使 26.7% 场景移出高紧急层级、关键层级分配增加 109%，但严重程度类别与深度测量一致性较弱。

papers.title: WaveletLoRA: Frequency-Aware Content-Style Decomposition for Personalized Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Content-style decomposition from a single image is a fundamental challenge in personalized image generation, aiming to separate subject identity from visual style for flexible recomposition. Existing approaches primarily operate in the spatial domain, without explicitly exploiting the distinct frequency characteristics naturally associated with content and style. In this paper, we propose WaveletLoRA, a novel frequency-aware framework for explicit content-style decomposition through wavelet-domain supervision. Specifically, we first apply a multi-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to decompose the reference image into low-frequency and high-frequency subbands. We then assign a dedicated LoRA branch to each subband, where the low-frequency branch models global appearance for style acquisition, while the high-frequency branches capture structural details for content preservation. To further improve disentanglement quality, we introduce a dense Mixture-of-Experts aggregation module together with a frequency-domain regularization objective, which reduces style leakage and enhance content fidelity. In addition, we establish WaveBench and develop a VLM-based evaluation protocol that explicitly measures both attribute similarity and attribute separation for disentanglement assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WaveletLoRA consistently outperforms existing methods and produces results that better align with human preference.
papers.abstract_zh: 从单张图像进行内容-风格分解是个性化图像生成中的一项基本挑战，旨在将主体身份与视觉风格分离以便灵活重组。现有方法主要在空间域操作，未显式利用内容与风格天然关联的独特频率特性。本文提出 WaveletLoRA，一个新颖的频率感知框架，通过小波域监督实现显式的内容-风格分解。具体而言，我们首先应用多级离散小波变换（DWT）将参考图像分解为低频和高频子带。然后为每个子带分配专用的 LoRA 分支，其中低频分支建模全局外观以获取风格，高频分支捕捉结构细节以保留内容。为进一步提升解耦质量，我们引入稠密专家混合聚合模块以及频域正则化目标，减少风格泄漏并增强内容保真度。此外，我们建立了 WaveBench，并开发了基于 VLM 的评估协议，显式衡量属性相似度和属性分离度以评估解耦效果。大量实验表明，WaveletLoRA 持续优于现有方法，并产生更符合人类偏好的结果。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出 WaveletLoRA，用小波变换将参考图分解为低频与高频子带并各配专用 LoRA 分支，结合专家混合聚合与频域正则化实现内容-风格解耦，并建立 WaveBench 与基于 VLM 的评估协议，实验持续优于现有方法。
evidence: 实验或理论证据信号：extensive experiment

papers.title: GLCR: Global-Local Collaborative Routing for Multi-Task Electromagnetic Signal Processing
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks for electromagnetic signal processing are typically developed as single-task experts with fixed inputs and objectives, limiting cross-task transferability. Electromagnetic foundation models offer broader task coverage but incur substantial pretraining and inference costs. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we adopt model routing to dynamically dispatch unknown signals to matched experts within a heterogeneous pool. We construct HeteroSignal-7, a multi-task routing benchmark with 140,000 samples from seven datasets covering six task types, paired with seven classification and waveform-recovery experts and a unified evaluation protocol. We then propose GLCR, a two-stage routing method combining global dispatch with local discrimination of similar tasks. First, a lightweight one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) with an additive-margin head predicts one of seven routing classes. Second, a gradient-boosted-tree specialist uses four physical statistics to re-evaluate samples whose top two candidates match a confusion pair automatically identified from validation errors. The pipeline is trained across the full signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range and requires neither SNR labels nor noise estimation at inference time. GLCR outperforms all 19 baselines, achieving 96.16% routing accuracy and a 76.30% system score, exceeding the respective second-best baselines by 1.16% and 1.14%. It achieves the lowest routing latency among the compared methods at 1.43 ms per sample and reduces expected overall system FLOPs by 5.9 times compared with executing all experts. This work provides a public evaluation platform and an efficient, reproducible baseline for heterogeneous expert routing in electromagnetic signal processing.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于电磁信号处理的深度神经网络通常被开发为具有固定输入和目标函数的单任务专家模型，限制了跨任务的可迁移性。电磁基础模型提供了更广的任务覆盖范围，但带来大量的预训练和推理开销。为平衡准确率与效率，我们采用模型路由，将未知信号动态分派到异构专家池中匹配的专家。我们构建了 HeteroSignal-7，这是一个多任务路由基准，包含来自七个数据集的 140,000 个样本，覆盖六种任务类型，并配有七个分类与波形恢复专家以及统一的评估协议。随后我们提出 GLCR，一种两阶段路由方法，将全局分派与相似任务的局部分辨相结合。首先，一个带有加性间隔头的轻量级一维卷积神经网络（CNN）预测七个路由类别之一。其次，一个梯度提升树专家使用四个物理统计量，对前两名候选构成从验证误差中自动识别出的混淆对的样本进行重新评估。该流程在完整信噪比（SNR）范围内训练，推理时既不需要 SNR 标签也不需要噪声估计。GLCR 优于全部 19 个基线，达到 96.16% 的路由准确率和 76.30% 的系统得分，分别超过对应的次优基线 1.16% 和 1.14%。在对比方法中，它实现了最低的路由延迟，为每样本 1.43 ms，并且与执行全部专家相比，将预期整体系统 FLOPs 降低 5.9 倍。本工作为电磁信号处理中的异构专家路由提供了公开评估平台和高效、可复现的基线。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出两阶段路由方法 GLCR，结合轻量级一维 CNN 全局分派与梯度提升树对混淆样本的局部分辨，在 HeteroSignal-7 基准上达到 96.16% 路由准确率，并显著降低延迟与系统 FLOPs。

papers.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.
papers.abstract_zh: 推理视觉语言模型（VLM）因大规模多模态上下文和不断增长的推理轨迹而产生大量 KV 缓存需求。低秩 KV 压缩已成为一种有前景的范式，它存储 KV 状态的低维潜表示，并可与量化结合。然而，现有低秩方法在压缩推理 KV 状态时，往往导致相对稠密模型不断增大的预测策略漂移，从而引发推理失败。我们识别出这种退化的两个关键原因：静态上下文与同策略推理状态之间的校准状态失配，以及 KV 状态之间不等的误差敏感性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TraceKV，一个免训练的低秩 KV 压缩框架，在单一策略保持原则下统一同策略校准、敏感性感知 SVD 和全局秩分配，从而在推理过程中大幅降低策略-KL 散度。跨多个 VLM 和视觉推理基准的实验展示了更优的准确率-内存权衡，在与量化结合时以 5.64 倍 KV 缓存压缩实现近乎无损的推理准确率。优化的低秩注意力内核进一步带来最高 1.83 倍的端到端解码加速。代码将发布于 https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出免训练低秩 KV 压缩框架 TraceKV，统一同策略校准、敏感性感知 SVD 与全局秩分配以降低策略漂移，结合量化实现 5.64 倍 KV 缓存压缩下的近乎无损推理准确率。
why_it_matters: 匹配 MLLM / VLM：vision-language model, vlm
匹配 效率：quantization, kv cache

papers.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大规模无标签语料上训练的基础模型会发展出涌现能力，即超越训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出Bonbon，一个在约3.2万亿token的配对蛋白质-配体序列上训练的分子相互作用基础模型。从单一表示空间出发，Bonbon在分层分辨率上展现三种零样本涌现能力：功能（作用机制）、残基（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构区分）和键（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均能泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon仅基于蛋白质-配体序列训练，没有任何任务特定监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从42M到1.6B参数的六个模型规模上进行受控缩放实验；在连续指标上，所评估的每种能力均在最大规模处出现急剧跃升，即使预训练损失平滑下降。这表明仅凭基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时可用。此处报告的能力在1:2,000的参数与token比例下训练后涌现，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。相同的冻结表示在比共折叠方法快五个数量级的速度下实现最先进的结合和亲和力预测。在涵盖七个蛋白质家族的九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon在从头化合物上达到61.5%的剂量反应命中率，产生结构新颖的分子，这些分子此前未被报道能抑制这些蛋白质，包括对分布外靶点。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出Bonbon分子相互作用基础模型，仅用蛋白质-配体序列训练即零样本涌现功能、残基和键层面的能力，并在湿实验中取得61.5%剂量反应命中率。

偏好加分 scaling-and-compute：scaling law, scaling laws

papers.title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
papers.abstract_en: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. However, most existing vectorization methods optimize for pixel-level render- ing fidelity, often producing SVGs that lack alignment with human-perceived object-part hierarchies, making them difficult to manipulate. To address this, we propose Lang-SVG, which introduces an explicit tree structure to organize SVG primitives with semantic labels and parent-child relationships. Lang-SVG incorporates granularity-controllable and open-vocabulary segmentation priors to initialize object-part hierarchies and leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with SVG tree context to assign semantic labels to unlabeled nodes. To reduce redundancy, we introduce depth-adaptive simplification to reduce shape complexity and Tree-Guided Pruning and Merging to eliminate redundant SVG nodes. L1-SAM-Prompting further recovers missing regions to improve recon- struction fidelity and structural completeness. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, we introduce a new evaluation protocol that measures structural quality and semantic part alignment. Experiments demonstrate that Lang-SVG achieves state-of-the-art performance in both rendering fidelity and structural quality. Project website: https://xiliu8006.github.io/Lang-SVG/.
why_it_matters: 匹配 LLM：large language model, language model
匹配 MLLM / VLM：multimodal large language model

papers.title: Looking One Step Ahead: An Anticipation-guided Agent for Object State Readout in Videos
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the progress of an activity requires tracking how the objects involved change over time. Object state readout provides this information by describing a target object's states and transitions across video frames. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate detailed visual descriptions, these descriptions may leave the attributes needed to distinguish successive states insufficiently specified. In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent for object state readout that uses possible next-step changes to determine which attributes to inspect in the present. Given temporally ordered frames and a target object, LASER converts anticipated changes into targeted visual questions and inspects the current frame to establish attribute values. It then checks state readouts and forecasts against independent observations of subsequent frames, refining a state record used to generate the final description. Reusable textual observation skills guide this process and are refined by tracing discrepancies with reference captions to the responsible instructions. Candidate revisions are selected on separate videos based on improved caption quality without increased contradictions with reference facts. Model parameters remain frozen throughout adaptation and inference, and the revised skills remain fixed during evaluation. Experiment results and further analysis on OSCaR and PLM RCap show consistent improvements of LASER over strong baselines and existing approaches, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解活动的进展需要跟踪所涉及物体如何随时间变化。物体状态读出通过描述目标物体在视频帧中的状态和转换来提供这一信息。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能生成详细的视觉描述，但这些描述可能未能充分指定区分连续状态所需的属性。在本文中，我们提出前瞻状态读出（LASER），一种用于物体状态读出的预期引导智能体，它使用可能的下一步变化来确定当前应检查哪些属性。给定按时间排序的帧和目标物体，LASER将预期的变化转化为有针对性的视觉问题，并检查当前帧以确定属性值。然后，它根据对后续帧的独立观测来检查状态读出和预测，精炼用于生成最终描述的状态记录。可复用的文本观测技能指导这一过程，并通过将差异追溯到参考字幕来精炼这些技能。候选修订在单独视频上根据字幕质量提升且不增加与参考事实的矛盾来选择。模型参数在适应和推理过程中保持冻结，修订后的技能在评估期间保持固定。在OSCaR和PLM RCap上的实验结果和进一步分析表明，LASER相比强基线和现有方法取得了一致改进，证明了我们方法的有效性。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出预期引导的智能体LASER，将可能的下一步变化转化为针对性视觉问题以读出当前物体状态，并用后续帧独立观测校验与精炼状态记录，在OSCaR和PLM RCap上一致优于强基线。

papers.title: Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种野火管理的新范式，利用深度学习（DL）检测可见火焰与被遮挡火焰。该方法的核心是对RGB视频进行联合的时空分析，利用连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式可指示被遮挡火焰这一事实。这一视角与独立分析图像和单个视频帧的传统方法形成对比。为此，我们提出一种逐帧Transformer架构，在连续帧之间应用注意力机制，同时保留帧内空间信息，这与非局部块等将时空信息合并为单一向量的常规注意力机制不同。我们还在不同空间分辨率下优化时间模式长度，以在降低计算成本的同时实现最高性能。为探究该方法在航拍图像处理中的适用性，我们将其应用于经过整理的FLAME2数据集，该数据集包含双模态RGB/IR视频。IR视频流用于提取真值，而模型仅在RGB视频上训练，以保持对低成本商用无人机（仅配备普通相机）的适用性，并便于处理仅含RGB的现有数据集。所提方法分别达到92.61%的分割前景Dice分数、93.21%和91.73%的目标检测精确率与召回率，以及98.02%的片段级分类准确率。我们还通过消融研究考察了该方法的有效性与泛化性。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出逐帧Transformer对RGB视频中烟雾的时空模式进行联合分析，以检测可见与被遮挡的野火火焰，在FLAME2数据集上取得92.61%分割Dice与98.02%片段级分类准确率。

papers.title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
papers.abstract_en: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.

papers.title: Dual Representation Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: The Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is a fundamental and challenging optimization problem in smart manufacturing. Although recent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches can learn effective scheduling policies through interaction with the environment, their performance often degrades as problem scale and processing-time uncertainty increase. In this paper, we propose DredRL, a dual representation enhanced diffusion-policy reinforcement learning scheduler. DredRL first constructs enhanced dual representations of operations and machines through self- and cross-attention mechanisms to capture both intra-entity and inter-entity dependencies. A diffusion model is further employed as the policy network, generating scheduling decisions through iterative denoising conditioned on the encoded state to enhance policy expressiveness and robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, public, large-scale, and stochastic FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that DredRL outperforms state-of-the-art learning-based schedulers across most configurations. Compared with SOTA learning-based methods, DredRL reduces makespan by up to 5.44% on synthetic instances. It also achieves the best learning-based performance on three of four public benchmarks and outperforms the stochasticity-aware algorithms on stochastic benchmarks. These results demonstrate that combining enhanced dual representations with diffusion-based policies provides an effective and robust approach for large scale scalable FJSP scheduling in complicated environment.

papers.title: Fine-Grained Generative Hallucination Detection and Correction for Aerial Image Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Aerial imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) plays a vital role in applications such as surveillance, disaster response, and large-scale environmental monitoring. Automatic generation of textual descriptions for such imagery is essential for reducing manual inspection overhead and enabling better downstream decision-making. However, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), despite their impressive captioning capabilities, are prone to hallucination, producing descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input. This problem is significantly amplified in aerial imagery due to its unique challenges such as extreme viewpoint variation, small objects, class imbalance, and ambiguous visual entities. Existing hallucination detection approaches either rely on computationally expensive large external models such as GPT-4, which perform poorly on aerial domains, or treat the problem as a rigid binary classification task, ignoring the inherent uncertainty in ambiguous cases. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight, reference-free framework for hallucination detection and correction in free-form aerial image captioning. Our method leverages state-of-the-art MLLMs, specifically InternVL3 and Qwen2.5-VL, to detect hallucinated content in generated captions with minimal computational overhead. Detected hallucinations are corrected through a dedicated refinement module that improves the factual consistency of the original captions. Extensive experiments on the Labelled Illusion Dataset (LID) demonstrate that our framework significantly reduces hallucination rates while remaining practical for real-time deployment in resource-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/Debolena7/Hal_Detect.

papers.title: Prior-as-Skill: Remember Outside and Read Inside with On-Policy Self-Distillation for Self-Evolving VLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving visual agents keep what they learn as skills: key frames with step notes on a task's steps and their order. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is now a popular way to train such skills into a vision-language model that matches, on its own answers, a teacher that also reads the written order. At deployment, frames often go missing or show an unusual order, as when a person or a website reorders the steps. Existing internalization methods keep any order they store in the frame-reading weights: trained on full frames, the model guesses when they are missing, and trained with frames withheld, it stores the order, so memory can override what it sees. We propose PriorSplit, which fills in missing frames from an order kept outside the model, with no training beyond OPSD. It counts which of two neighboring steps comes first in training episodes, and the model checks if both asked steps are in view: if so, it answers from the frames, and otherwise the counts answer. Extensive experiments on synthetic skills with five models and on step-tagged order questions in new episodes of seen web, cooking and egocentric tasks demonstrate that, with frames missing, PriorSplit outperforms every compared method at OPSD's training cost. With Qwen3-VL-4B on synthetic skills, it also stays close to OPSD on unusual orders, where methods that gain most by storing the order fall behind.

papers.title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
papers.abstract_en: Formal verification using proof assistants provides strong correctness guarantees for software, but constructing proofs remains labor-intensive and requires significant expertise. Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating proof synthesis. However, these approaches typically constrain the model to a rigid tactic-generation loop, in which the surrounding system controls premise retrieval, proof-state management, and backtracking. We introduce ProofCoder, an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that approaches theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective. Rather than generating tactics within a fixed loop, ProofCoder reasons continuously throughout proof search and uses proof-assistant feedback to decide when to gather additional information, inspect proof states, revise previously generated proof fragments, or backtrack to an earlier point in the proof. This allows it to iteratively construct, repair, and refine proofs, at either tactic-level or whole-proof granularity. We evaluate ProofCoder on 280 challenging verification tasks from the AutoRocq Benchmark. On the best-performing configurations, ProofCoder increases proof success from 47% to 60% over the state-of-theart AutoRocq system, corresponding to a 27.7% relative improvement at approximately half the cost. Our ablations identify continuous reasoning as a key design choice: without it, the agent solves fewer lemmas at substantially higher cost, backtracks four to six times more often, and more frequently discards its own revisions. Whole-proof and tactic-level generation achieve similar success rates but follow distinct search and repair strategies. These results suggest that effective automated software verification requires more than improved tactic selection: continuous reasoning and feedback-guided proof revision are critical ingredients for robust proof synthesis.
papers.abstract_zh: 使用证明助手的形式化验证为软件提供了强正确性保证，但构造证明仍然劳动密集且需要大量专业知识。基于大语言模型（LLM）的近期方法在自动化证明合成方面显示出前景。然而，这些方法通常将模型限制在僵化的策略生成循环中，由周围系统控制前提检索、证明状态管理和回溯。我们引入ProofCoder，一个面向Rocq的智能体式证明合成系统，从编码智能体的视角处理定理证明。ProofCoder不在固定循环内生成策略，而是在整个证明搜索过程中持续推理，并利用证明助手反馈来决定何时收集额外信息、检查证明状态、修订先前生成的证明片段或回溯到证明中的较早位置。这使其能够在策略级或整体证明粒度上迭代构造、修复和精炼证明。我们在AutoRocq基准的280个挑战性验证任务上评估ProofCoder。在表现最佳的配置上，ProofCoder将证明成功率从47%提升至60%，相比最先进的AutoRocq系统，在约一半成本下实现27.7%的相对提升。我们的消融实验确定持续推理是关键设计选择：没有它，智能体解决的引理更少且成本显著更高，回溯频率高四到六倍，并更频繁地丢弃自己的修订。整体证明和策略级生成达到相似的成功率，但遵循不同的搜索和修复策略。这些结果表明，有效的自动化软件验证需要的不仅仅是改进的策略选择：持续推理和反馈引导的证明修订是稳健证明合成的关键要素。
papers.tldr_zh: 提出面向Rocq的智能体式证明合成系统ProofCoder，以持续推理和证明助手反馈引导信息收集、状态检查、修订与回溯，在AutoRocq基准上将证明成功率从47%提升至60%，相对提升27.7%且成本约减半。

papers.title: EVAThink: Evidence Sufficiency-Guided Training for Adaptive Thinking in Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Under a fixed frame budget, video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) depends on whether the sampled frames provide sufficient evidence for the question. Sufficient frame evidence supports direct answering, whereas less informative observations may benefit from reasoning that connects the available cues. We introduce EVAThink, which enhances video understanding through evidence sufficiency-guided training for adaptive thinking. First, Recoverable Evidence Gap Mining constructs evidence-dense and evidence-sparse video views that share the same question and answer under an identical frame budget. It retains pairs where sparse views yield lower direct-answer accuracy than dense views but benefit from explicit reasoning, providing supervision for response-mode selection. Second, Evidence-Guided Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning uses stage-specific rewards to guide training with evidence-based mode preferences and then refine response efficiency, while first-token advantage regularization mitigates mode collapse. Trained on only 6.7K curated samples, EVAThink consistently improves upon the base model across video understanding benchmarks under both 32- and 64-frame budgets, while outperforming strong baselines on average. The code, model, and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/EVAThink}{EVAThink}.

papers.title: StateAlign: Internalizing State-Aware Decision-Making for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has improved the tool-use capabilities of large language models. However, better task performance can coincide with increased tool hallucination. Reliable tool use requires decisions to follow the current task state: available information, tool capabilities, and task progress. Our analysis shows that agents sometimes execute when they should ask for information, retrieve it, or decline an infeasible request, even when reasoning identifies missing information. We introduce StateAlign, combining task-state construction with state-contrastive reinforcement learning. The data cover five task conditions and pair states with different action requirements. Outcome rewards guide task completion; token-level contrasts compare the same generated reasoning and actions under paired states to train outputs that fit the current state. Experiments across five base models from three families show improvements on BFCL v4 multi-turn, ToolSandbox, and When2Call. Ablations show that state construction improves performance and reliability under different reward designs. The complete method further reduces tool hallucination across three Qwen3 sizes. On Qwen3-8B, StateAlign improves BFCL v4 multi-turn accuracy from 45.5% to 55.2% and reduces no-tool hallucination on SimpleToolHalluBench from 62.2% under outcome-only training to 56.1%. Behavioral analyses show more consistent decisions, more complete multi-call execution, and stronger recovery after tool errors.

papers.title: OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.

papers.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.

papers.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
papers.abstract_en: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.

papers.title: Sable: A Small-Field Sumcheck Argument for Bit-Exact Inference of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Sable, an argument system and single-GPU prover for the statement that a committed, integer-quantized transformer produced a given token sequence from a given prompt, bit for bit. Sable fixes an integer function F_O with no floating-point step, in which every rounding, normalization, softmax and sampling decision is determined by its inputs, and proves it with a constraint system whose relations provably never wrap modulo the 31-bit KoalaBear prime. The proof batches zerochecks and LogUp-GKR lookups into one sumcheck per domain, and commits to every witness tensor and weight in one multilinear commitment built from Reed-Solomon codes, BLAKE3 Merkle trees and a mixed-length BaseFold opening. The prover streams the model layer by layer on one GPU. On one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, Sable proves all 64 layers of Qwen2.5-32B in 92.5 s for 4,096 tokens and 398 s for 16,384 tokens, and covers Qwen3-32B and the mixture-of-experts Qwen3-30B-A3B (4,096 tokens in 121.8 and 84.7 s). A proof costs 41 to 50 times the serving time, or 6.4 cents per 4,096-token request at public GPU prices, and 40 to 64 times less time per parameter and token than zkLLM. On WikiText-2, F_O's greedy token matches the BF16 model's at 86.3% of positions; on Qwen3, F_O is within 1.6 points of BF16 on MMLU and 1.7 points on GSM8K. A verifier with a compiled core checks a proof on one CPU core in 19 to 56 s. In the random-oracle model, the interactive proof has round-by-round soundness error 2^-103. The proof is not zero-knowledge, so the system targets open-weight models. Code: https://github.com/moonmath-ai/Sable

papers.title: Reward-Driven Collider Physics Challenges for Self-Improving Agentic AI via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in agentic AI have demonstrated the potential to automate complex high-energy physics (HEP) workflows. We focus on the regime of HEP tasks where frontier models still struggle to provide correct and complete solutions, and introduce an open-ended optimization task format with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards. Unlike conventional benchmarks focused on task completion, these tasks target reinforcement learning (RL) environments to generate agentic improvement on state- of-the-art HEP challenges. We benchmark frontier reasoning models on several HEP tasks and demonstrate an initial proof of concept in which a small language model improves through RL using automated feedback without human intervention. By connecting challenging HEP problems with verifiable scientific rewards and RL, we aim to advance agentic AI from reproducing established workflows to autonomously discovering better scientific solutions, paving the way toward self-improving scientific agents.

papers.title: Ceci n'est pas une pipe -- Toward a Symbolic Solver for the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus Using Evolutionary Computation
papers.abstract_en: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is a benchmark designed to assess the capability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems to generalize starting from a few samples, a task humans excel at. The ARC-AGI contests held since 2020 have been the focus of intense competition, with participants proposing approaches ranging from traditional symbolic AI to Transformer architectures. Despite a long history of successes, evolutionary algorithms (EAs) were notably absent from the approaches appearing in the main contest. As score-and-search program synthesis approaches, EAs suffer from issues related to choosing the proper representation in the Domain-Specific Language applied to the problem (for example, pixel-level or object-level), and distinguishing between two candidate solutions producing the same outputs. In this work, we present the first fully symbolic, evolutionary-based program synthesis approach submitted to the ARC-AGI-2 main contest. The main contributions are: evolving the grid parser and the output projector together with the program that transforms the grid, so that a task-specific language emerges during program synthesis; grounding the symbols the parser can extract in core knowledge theory from cognitive psychology; and an object-aware fitness that grades partially correct outputs beyond pixel-level discrepancies.

papers.title: CASCADE: Constraint-Aware SCAffolded DEcomposition for Logical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Logical Anomaly Detection (LAD) requires verifying whether all category-specific constraints, such as object counts, pairing relations, and measurement ranges, are satisfied by a query image given only a few normal references. Recent LAD methods based on Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) formulate this as checklist verification, decomposing the decision into independent textual checks. This decomposition, however, is text-only. Every item still reads the same unmodified query image, so the LVLM must extract different forms of visual evidence from one raw image. We identify this text-image mismatch as a constraint-specific perception gap, the source of two failure modes: instance conflation for binding constraints and scale drift for calibration constraints. To diagnose whether these failures stem from insufficient reasoning or insufficient perception, we compare textual reasoning guides and visual perception guides in a training-free setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning over the same image provides little benefit, whereas adapting the visual input to each constraint substantially improves verification accuracy. Based on this finding, we propose CASCADE, a training-free framework that extends checklist decomposition using constraint-specific visual scaffolds. We further introduce CASCADE++, which adapts these scaffolds at the object level by deriving their configurations from the constraint structure and reference distribution. Across MVTec-LOCO and VID-AD, CASCADE++ surpasses the full-shot state of the art by 3.9 AUROC points with only three references, and improves over the strongest VID-AD baseline by 11.4, transferring across multiple LVLM backbones without any training.

papers.title: Turning Multi-Agent Communication into Token-Level Credit with On Policy Self Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning improves problem solving in large language model multi-agent systems. Existing approaches overlook communication knowledge or compress it into scalar rewards, leaving coarse credit with little guidance on which decisions each agent should reinforce or revise. OPSD4MAS converts future communication into fine-grained token-level credit through On Policy Self Distillation (OPSD). An external model extracts facts and assesses their trajectory relations for coarse-grained filtering, followed by fine-grained leave-one-out filtering of target-token influence against agent-wise outcome advantages. The fact-conditioned policy supplies token-level credit, combined with GRPO through a linearly annealed joint objective. Our method improves mathematical pass@4 over GRPO by up to 20.00 percentage points. Ablations support complete filtering, while frozen-history injection diagnostics support fact utility. Together, these results support combining agent-level outcome guidance with communication-derived token-level credit. Code is available at https://github.com/Camel-Prince/OPSD4MAS.

papers.title: Sub-actions in Action: Text-Guided Hand-Role Alignment for Sub-Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Our objective is to enhance VLMs ability to distinguish the roles of the left and right hands in egocentric actions. We introduce sub-action detection, a task that requires models to explicitly recognise the left- and right-hand roles and their manipulated objects within an ongoing high-level action. To address this challenge, we propose BiScopeNet, a framework that augments existing video-LLMs without modifying their vision encoders or language models. BiScopeNet incorporates two components: FocusAlign, a gated text-guided attention-based module that selectively aligns video features with textual context to emphasise action-relevant cues, and MetaLoss, a masked, object-weighted loss that prioritises visually grounded terms. To supervise sub-action detection, we introduce BiScopeCap-100K, a large-scale video-level dataset curated from existing egocentric datasets, providing dense captions that jointly describe high-level actions, left/right-hand roles, and manipulated objects, enriched with spatial metadata for grounding. Across the evaluated Video-LLM backbones, BiScopeNet improves action, hand-role, and object recognition over the corresponding supervised baselines, achieving the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated configurations on BiScopeCap.

papers.title: Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Thompson sampling is natural randomized strategy for optimizing unknown functions in a black-box manner. In continuous global optimization, Thompson sampling has largely been restricted to Gaussian process priors, as these are essentially the only class for which computing the posterior distribution has been tractable in practice. In this work, we introduce \emph{prior-fitted diffusion transformers}, which are diffusion models that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, after being pre-trained using the prior-fitted network paradigm. To apply these models, we develop a set of practical non-Gaussian priors for general black-box functions---including those that have characteristics that cannot be achieved under Gaussianity, such as priors over unimodal functions. We also quantify the tradeoff between model size and the number of pre-training iterations, and show that these models follow scaling laws akin to those observed in transformers defined over other modalities. Across a set of global optimization benchmarks, we show that prior-fitted diffusion transformers with non-Gaussian priors can achieve improved performance compared to traditional pipelines built on Gaussian processes.

papers.title: SlipStream: Enabling HBF for GPU Systems by Mitigating the Latency and SRAM Overheads
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference demands ever more memory capacity for larger models and batch sizes. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) replaces the DRAM dies of HBM with NAND flash and provides up to 16x the capacity at comparable read bandwidth. However, HBF can incur a read latency of nearly 20$μ$s, 20x that of HBM, so on-demand HBF accesses slow inference by up to 12.8x. Conventional cache-line prefetchers require 20x more in-flight tracking state to cover this latency. Tensor-streaming designs, such as H3, follow virtual-address order as opposed to kernel-demand order, and therefore need hundreds of megabytes of buffering. We propose SlipStream, a software-hardware co-designed prefetcher that turns prefetching into a demand-paced producer-consumer pipeline. In software, SlipStream profiles the repeatable weight-page demand order of data-independent LLM kernels and inserts a staging warp that replays this order with non-blocking STAGE instructions. In hardware, the staging warp acts as the producer and the work warps as consumers. Our key insight is to retire each STAGE tracking entry only when demand first accesses the page, as opposed to when the page returns from HBF. Demand thus paces staging and bounds how far staging leads consumption. SlipStream tracks 4 KB pages instead of cache lines and allocates buffer slots only when pages return, which decouples the buffer size from outstanding traffic. Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3 achieves only 43.1%, even with a 320 MB buffer. The buffer sizing of SlipStream is independent of HBF latency and workload. SlipStream with 16 MB buffer, 20x smaller than that of H3, performs within 4% of SlipStream-40MB. SlipStream also supports Mixture-of-Experts models and reaches 91.2% of ideal performance (40 MB buffer).

papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

papers.title: Sophon: A Procedural Diagnostic for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) score 85-94% on spatial benchmarks (BLINK Spatial, What's Up CLEVR) yet collapse to chance on simple geometric questions when object, scene, and texture priors are stripped away. We introduce and open-source Sophon, a procedurally generated diagnostic of paired colored point-cloud stimuli across three coordinate systems (1D linear, 2D Cartesian, 2D polar) and four question types (binary, categorical, comparative, quantitative). Across four open architectures (LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2.5-VL, Idefics3), accuracy clusters at 47-52% while frontier models (Opus 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5.4) clear 77-83% and humans reach 84-94%. We use linear probes and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to trace the open-weight failures. Probes of the vision encoder (ViT) and language decoder (LLM) recover Sophon spatial information at 83-85% and 80-86% accuracy, respectively, and the language tower's reasoning circuit answers text-only controls (point clouds as sets of coordinates) at +40 pp over visual stimuli. Language tower per-layer attention attribution localizes visual integration to mid-stack layers. At readout, models elevate the correct answer-set tokens but select among them randomly. We localize the mechanism by tuning individual and grouped components across every architecture's stack, including the vision tower (ViT workspace and reader), the projector, and the language tower (LLM workspace and reader). These experiments demonstrate that this mid-stack workspace holds circuitry capable of organizing the spatial signal so that the frozen reader can decode it. LoRA fine-tuning adjusts that circuitry such that 7B-class VLMs answer Sophon spatial reasoning questions at frontier aggregate accuracy. This work suggests that these models do not have a capability gap for spatial reasoning but suffer from a routing bottleneck that targeted fine-tuning repairs.
